description: This Kotlin source file defines the class `ProcessRemoteActions`, which manages processing remote CRUD operations (create, update, delete) for notes in a synchronized manner. It queues operations, debounces rapid changes, checks backend availability, and performs asynchronous remote calls while tracking ongoing jobs. It facilitates remote synchronization within the application.

classes.name: ProcessRemoteActions
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and executing remote note operations, including debouncing, queuing, and asynchronous processing with concurrency control.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main operator function that processes a remote operation for a given noteId, handling batching, debouncing, and backend availability checks before executing create, update, or delete operations asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteRemoteNotes
methods.description: Performs remote deletion of notes using the backend provider, and updates local mapping accordingly.

methods.name: insertRemote
methods.description: Performs remote insertion of a note and updates local mappings and last modified timestamp.

methods.name: updateRemote
methods.description: Performs remote update of a note and updates local mappings accordingly.
